rules.sentence: Accurate identification requires a multidisciplinary approach that integrates clinical evaluation, advanced imaging, histopathologic assessment, immunohistochemistry, and molecular testing to distinguish SFTs from other spindle cell neoplasms.

Participants learn to interpret characteristic imaging and immunohistochemical findings, recognize the significance of the NAB2–STAT6 fusion, and apply evidence-based strategies for surgical, radiotherapeutic, and systemic management.
